description: Static assertions for helix-cad-redraw — redraw 2D DXF sheets after the original + deterministic layout gates. Checks that the rules learned on a real ~30-sheet redraw are stated with their enforcement point: template = original split sheet, internal inconsistencies decided in words, per-sheet A/B choice, fixed gate chain, image review, merge with audit.
test_input: vẽ lại bộ bản vẽ DXF theo bản gốc, kích thước quá sát

assertions.name: template_is_original
assertions.check: redraw scripts take their template only from the ORIGINAL split sheets

assertions.name: inconsistencies_in_words
assertions.check: internal inconsistencies listed by written_vs_drawn.py and decided by the owner in words, not option letters

assertions.name: per_sheet_mode
assertions.check: per-sheet choice keep-original-geometry vs parametric; schematic sections keep the original
assertions.regex: \(A\) giữ hình học gốc[\s\S]{0,200}sơ đồ ⇒ A

assertions.name: gate_chain
assertions.check: fixed gate chain spacing → overlap → notes strokes → label diff

assertions.name: frame_gate
assertions.check: dims outside the sheet border are reported and classified outward/view

assertions.name: image_review
assertions.check: owner approves images (original | redraw pair), a green gate is not approval

assertions.name: keep_as_original
assertions.check: where the original is also tight, keep the original placement and log why instead of forcing the gate
assertions.regex: giữ như gốc, ghi lý do

assertions.name: merge_audit
assertions.check: merge with audit + sha256, then rerun the gates on the whole set

assertions.name: mutation_tested
assertions.check: tools are mutation-tested; a new rule needs a test + mutant
assertions.regex: Thêm luật mới ⇒ thêm test \+ đột biến

assertions.name: local_only_for_classified
assertions.check: classified dossiers: local scripts only, no LLM agent reads geometry
